data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 25.445m (balance sheet prior-year column). During 2017 there was a gross prior-year release of GBP 8.936m (approximately 35.1% of opening reserves), recorded in the technical provisions note as an "over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses". The movement reflects favourable claims development and the absence of major catastrophe activity in the affected prior years (2015 and 2016). The syndicate is predominantly a reinsurance (treaty) vehicle and the prior-year release was recorded at the consolidated syndicate level.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior-year development extracted from Technical Provisions note line "Over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses" (gross figure). Development triangle for gross claims is present and consistent with the note. Named catastrophe events (Harvey/Irma/Maria) are mentioned as materially impacting 2017 but are not quantified at syndicate-level in the annual accounts; prior-year releases are not allocated by LOB within the note.
